# tabula

State machines as a matrix the compiler checks and a reviewer can read.

- [Diagnostics](https://anthropic-tabula.github.io/tabula/diagnostics) — every error code, its message, and why
  it exists. Linked from the messages themselves.
- [Cells](https://anthropic-tabula.github.io/tabula/cells) — the normative semantics of the six cell kinds.
- [Matrix files](https://anthropic-tabula.github.io/tabula/matrix-files) — the `*.tb.` convention and how to
  stop general-purpose formatters from flattening a matrix.

Everything here is generated from `spec/` in the repository. The spec is
